ModMetaData.name: RimScent Extended
ModMetaData.author: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
The engine layer for RimScent: five bug fixes, two mechanics it was missing, and two extension points it did not have. On its own it adds almost no content — it is what the seven RimScent Extended expansions are built on.
ENGINE FIXES (Harmony patch — the original mod is neither forked nor modified) - A switched-off incense burner kept perfuming the room forever. The scan tested fuel and power, never the switch. - A dangling else removed all room separation for a colonist indoors, who could smell adjacent rooms and the outdoors through walls. - Trait-degree fields (dysosmicTraitDegrees, anosmicTraitDegrees) fired for everyone without ever checking the pawn. - Per-scent anosmia tripled the smell instead of cancelling it. - A possible exception every tick if another mod placed the comp on anything but humans.
TWO MECHANICS, TOGGLEABLE IN THE OPTIONS - Olfactory adaptation. A constant smell stops being noticed, and hits again after time away. Without it, a colonist living next to a barn is unhappy forever with no way to get used to it. Floor, duration, and whether pleasant smells fade too, are all adjustable. - Temperature. Heat makes odours volatile, cold locks them down. A scent is at 40% below -10C, full strength at 20C, and 160% at 45C and above. Refrigerating a pile of corpses finally does something for your nose.
THREE EXTENSION POINTS FOR OTHER MODS RimScent can attach one ThoughtDef to a thing. That is all. These add: - ModExtension_PawnScent — a scent carried by a pawn def, gated on a stat threshold. RimScent reads only a neighbour's hediffs, never their race def, so animals and creatures could not smell at all. - ModExtension_ScentHediff — a scent that also applies a HediffDef, so a smell can do something rather than only be liked or disliked. - ModExtension_TerrainScent — a scent carried by the ground itself. RimScent reads only the thing grid, and terrain is not a thing: water, mud, sand and ice have no ThingDef at all. Counted per tile, and optionally gated on temperature — a marsh only smells when it is warm.
All three are documented in the README, with examples.
ALSO INCLUDED The one thought RimScent defines in its core and never translates, in French, and the scan support for corpses and spoiled food — reading rot stage, which no def can express. The thoughts that go with that reading live in the Decay expansion; without it the socle simply stays silent.
THE EXPANSIONS Incense Plus, Perfume Plus, Everyday Life, Decay, Farmyard, Industry and Weather. Each is optional, each declares this mod as a dependency, and each covers one theme.
No save data is added: it can be added to or removed from an ongoing game. Requires RimScent.
